sql.rebate.updateTotalPromotionAmount: update flow.project_process_step_custom_field_value set numeric_value = :newTotal where id = (select pscfv.id from flow.project p inner join flow.project_process_step pps on pps.project_id = p.id and pps.process_step_id = 4 inner join flow.project_process_step_custom_field_value pscfv on pps.id = pscfv.project_process_step_id inner join flow.custom_field_group_assignment cfga on cfga.id = pscfv.custom_field_group_assignment_id inner join flow.custom_field_group cfg on cfg.id = cfga.custom_field_group_id inner join flow.custom_field cf on cf.id = cfga.custom_field_id inner join flow.company_data_type cdt on cf.company_data_type_id = cdt.id inner join flow.data_type dt on dt.id = cdt.data_type_id where cfga.custom_field_id = (select id from flow.custom_field where field_name='Total Promotion Amount') and p.id = :projectId);
sql.rebate.getOne: select prp.id, prp.payment_amount, prp.created_date, prp.created_by_user_id, prp.approved_by_user_id, prp.approved_date, prp.project_id, prp.processed_by_user_id, prp.processed_date, prp.project_rebate_payment_state_id as payment_state_id, from brs.project_rebate_payment prp INNER JOIN flow.project p on p.id = prp.project_id where prp.id = :paymentId
sql.rebate.approvePayments: update brs.project_rebate_payment set approved_by_user_id = :userId, approved_date = (now() at time zone 'US/Mountain')::date, project_rebate_payment_state_id = 2 where id in (:paymentIds);
sql.rebate.assignPaymentsToBatch: update brs.project_rebate_payment set updated_by_user_id = :userId, updated_date = (now() at time zone 'US/Mountain')::date, project_rebate_payment_state_id = 3, project_rebate_batch_id = :batchId where id in (:paymentIds);
sql.rebate.getBatchDetails: select drb.id, drb.batch_date, drb.updated_date, drb.voided_batch, drb.updated_by_user_id, case when drb.updated_by_user_id is null then 'System' else u.first_name || ' ' || u.last_name end as updated_by_user, coalesce(( SELECT array_to_json(array_agg(row_to_json(rebatePayments))) FROM ( select prp.id, prp.payment_amount as "paymentAmount", prp.payment_nbr as "paymentNbr", s.customer_name as "projectName", prp.check_number as "checkNumber", prp.project_rebate_payment_state_id as "paymentStateId", prp.project_id as "projectId" from brs.project_rebate_payment prp INNER JOIN flow.project p on p.id = prp.project_id INNER JOIN brs.project_commission_snapshot s ON s.project_id = p.id where prp.project_rebate_batch_id = drb.id and s.id = (select max(id) from brs.project_commission_snapshot where project_id = p.id) group by prp.id, prp.payment_nbr, s.customer_name order by payment_nbr) rebatePayments), '[]') AS "rebatePayments" from brs.project_rebate_batch drb LEFT JOIN flow."user" u on u.id = drb.updated_by_user_id where drb.id = :batchId
sql.rebate.voidBatch: update brs.project_rebate_batch set voided_batch = true, updated_by_user_id = :userId, updated_date = now() where id = :batchId
sql.rebate.voidSinglePayment: update brs.project_rebate_payment set updated_by_user_id = :userId, updated_date = now(), project_rebate_payment_state_id = 5, void_note = :note where id = :paymentId
sql.rebate.updatePaymentNote: update brs.project_rebate_payment set updated_by_user_id = :userId, updated_date = now(), void_note = :note where id = :paymentId
sql.rebate.voidBatchPayments: update brs.project_rebate_payment set project_rebate_batch_id = null, updated_by_user_id = :userId, updated_date = now(), project_rebate_payment_state_id = 1, check_number = null where project_rebate_batch_id = :batchId
sql.rebate.getAllBatches: select drb.id, drb.batch_date, drb.updated_date, drb.voided_batch, drb.updated_by_user_id, case when drb.updated_by_user_id is null then 'System' else u.first_name || ' ' || u.last_name end as updated_by_user from brs.project_rebate_batch drb LEFT JOIN flow."user" u on u.id = drb.updated_by_user_id order by drb.batch_date desc
sql.rebate.getPaymentsPending: select * from ( select p.id project_id, s.customer_name project_name, s.sc, coalesce((select sum(prp2.payment_amount)from brs.project_rebate_payment prp2 where prp2.project_id = p.id and project_rebate_payment_state_id = 3),0) total_paid, (select sum(prp2.payment_amount)from brs.project_rebate_payment prp2 where prp2.project_id = p.id and project_rebate_payment_state_id = 3) payment_sum, coalesce(prps.name,'New') state, (select first_name || ' ' || last_name from flow.user where id = prp.created_by_user_id) as createdBy, pd.primary_financier as financier, pd.num_of_promotion_payments as numberOfPromotionPayments, pd.product, pd.total_promotion_amount, pcfv.date_value as entered_into_payment_system_date from flow.project p left outer join brs.project_commission_snapshot s ON s.project_id = p.id left outer join brs.project_rebate_payment prp on p.id = prp.project_id left outer join brs.project_rebate_payment_state prps on prp.project_rebate_payment_state_id = prps.id left outer join flow.project_process_step pps on pps.project_id = p.id and pps.process_step_id = 4 left outer join flow.project_process_step_custom_field_value pscfv on pps.id = pscfv.project_process_step_id left outer join flow.custom_field_group_assignment cfga on cfga.id = pscfv.custom_field_group_assignment_id left outer join flow.custom_field_group cfg on cfg.id = cfga.custom_field_group_id left outer join flow.custom_field cf on cf.id = cfga.custom_field_id left outer join flow.company_data_type cdt on cf.company_data_type_id = cdt.id left outer join flow.data_type dt on dt.id = cdt.data_type_id left join brs.project_details pd on pd.project_id = p.id left join flow.project_custom_field_value pcfv on p.id = pcfv.project_id and pcfv.custom_field_group_assignment_id = 369 left join flow.custom_field_group_assignment enterSysDate on enterSysDate.id = pcfv.custom_field_group_assignment_id and enterSysDate.custom_field_id = 580 where sc is not null and cfga.custom_field_id = (select id from flow.custom_field where field_name = 'Product') and pscfv.int_value is not null and s.id = (select max(id) from brs.project_commission_snapshot where project_id = p.id) ) as payments where payments.entered_into_payment_system_date != null
sql.rebate.getPaymentsNeedApproval: select prp.id payment_id, p.id project_id, s.customer_name project_name, s.sc, (select batch_date::date from brs.project_rebate_payment prp1 inner join brs.project_rebate_batch drb on drb.id = prp1.project_rebate_batch_id where project_rebate_payment_state_id = 3 and prp1.project_id = p.id order by payment_nbr desc limit 1) as last_payment_date, prp.payment_amount, coalesce((select sum(prp2.payment_amount)from brs.project_rebate_payment prp2 where prp2.project_id = p.id and project_rebate_payment_state_id = 3),0) total_paid, (select max(payment_nbr) from brs.project_rebate_payment where project_id = p.id and project_rebate_payment_state_id = 3) last_payment, (select min(payment_nbr) from brs.project_rebate_payment where project_id = p.id and project_rebate_payment_state_id = 1) next_scheduled_payment, prps.name state, case when (select count(1) from brs.project_rebate_payment where project_id = p.id and payment_nbr < prp.payment_nbr and project_rebate_payment_state_id=1)>0 then false else true end approvable, (select first_name || ' ' || last_name from flow.user where id = prp.created_by_user_id) as createdBy, pd.primary_financier as financier, pd.num_of_promotion_payments as numberOfPromotionPayments, pd.product, pd.total_promotion_amount, pd.entered_into_payment_system_date, false as selected from flow.project p inner join brs.project_commission_snapshot s ON s.project_id = p.id inner join brs.project_rebate_payment prp on p.id = prp.project_id inner join brs.project_rebate_payment_state prps on prp.project_rebate_payment_state_id = prps.id left join brs.project_details pd on pd.project_id = p.id where prp.payment_nbr = (select min(payment_nbr) from brs.project_rebate_payment prp1 where prp.project_id = prp1.project_id and prp1.project_rebate_payment_state_id = 1) and s.id = (select max(id) from brs.project_commission_snapshot where project_id = p.id)
sql.rebate.getPaymentsUnbalanced: select * from ( select p.id project_id, s.customer_name project_name, s.sc, sum(prp.payment_amount) payment_amount, coalesce((select sum(prp2.payment_amount)from brs.project_rebate_payment prp2 where prp2.project_id = p.id and project_rebate_payment_state_id = 3),0) total_paid, (select first_name || ' ' || last_name from flow.user where id = prp.created_by_user_id) as createdBy, pd.primary_financier as financier, pd.num_of_promotion_payments as numberOfPromotionPayments, pd.product, pd.total_promotion_amount, pd.entered_into_payment_system_date from flow.project p inner join brs.project_commission_snapshot s ON s.project_id = p.id inner join brs.project_rebate_payment prp on p.id = prp.project_id left join brs.project_details pd on pd.project_id = p.id where s.id = (select max(id) from brs.project_commission_snapshot where project_id = p.id) group by p.id, s.customer_name, s.sc, primary_financier, num_of_promotion_payments, entered_into_payment_system_date, product, total_promotion_amount, entered_into_payment_system_date, coalesce((select sum(prp2.payment_amount) from brs.project_rebate_payment prp2 where prp2.project_id = p.id and project_rebate_payment_state_id = 3),0), (select first_name || ' ' || last_name from flow.user where id = prp.created_by_user_id) ) payments where payments.total_promotion_amount != payments.total_paid AND (payments.total_promotion_amount - payments.total_paid > 0)
sql.rebate.getRebateDetails: select array_to_json(array_agg(row_to_json(results))) from ( select p.id project_id, s.customer_name as project_name, s.sc, (total_promotion_amount)/(num_of_promotion_payments)::numeric as payment_amount, c.id as contact_id, c.street1, c.street2, c.city, c.state, c.postal_code, c.mailing_street1, c.mailing_street2, c.mailing_city, c.mailing_state, c.mailing_postal_code, pd.primary_financier as financier, pd.num_of_promotion_payments as numberOfPromotionPayments, pd.product, pd.total_promotion_amount, pd.entered_into_payment_system_date, coalesce((select sum(drp2.payment_amount)from brs.project_rebate_payment drp2 where drp2.project_id = p.id and project_rebate_payment_state_id = 3),0) total_paid, (select sum(drp2.payment_amount)from brs.project_rebate_payment drp2 where drp2.project_id = p.id and project_rebate_payment_state_id = 3) payment_sum, ((select sum(payment_amount) from brs.project_rebate_payment drp3 where drp3.project_id = p.id and project_rebate_payment_state_id != 4) < (total_promotion_amount)::numeric) red_balanced_owed, (total_promotion_amount - (select sum(drp2.payment_amount) from brs.project_rebate_payment drp2 where drp2.project_id = p.id and project_rebate_payment_state_id = 3)) balance_owed, (select array_to_json(array_agg(row_to_json(payment_history))) from (select drp.id, batch_date, payment_amount, s.name, s.id as payment_state_id, payment_nbr, drb.id as batch_id, drp.check_number, drp.void_note from brs.project_rebate_payment drp left join brs.project_rebate_batch drb on drb.id = drp.project_rebate_batch_id inner join brs.project_rebate_payment_state s on project_rebate_payment_state_id = s.id where project_id = p.id order by payment_nbr)payment_history) payment_history from flow.project p inner join brs.project_commission_snapshot s ON s.project_id = p.id inner join brs.project_rebate_payment drp on p.id = drp.project_id inner join flow.contact c on c.id = p.contact_id left join brs.project_details pd on pd.project_id = p.id where p.id = :projectId and s.id = (select max(id) from brs.project_commission_snapshot where project_id = p.id) group by p.id, s.customer_name, s.sc, total_promotion_amount, num_of_promotion_payments, payment_amount, c.id, c.street1, c.street2, c.city, c.state, c.postal_code, c.mailing_street1, c.mailing_street2, c.mailing_city, c.mailing_state, c.mailing_postal_code, primary_financier, product, entered_into_payment_system_date, coalesce((select sum(drp2.payment_amount)from brs.project_rebate_payment drp2 where drp2.project_id = p.id and project_rebate_payment_state_id = 3),0) ) results
